title: Carter praying with his head on the table after the briefing

tellings.quote: Alonzo told us that Jimmy or Cart President Carter has a habit of putting his head down on his table like this and praying.

plain: After President Jimmy Carter was briefed on UFOs in 1977, he put his head down on the table and prayed, according to Alonzo McDonald, a man said to have confirmed the briefing. The physicist Eric W. Davis tells Michels that McDonald told this to him and others, including a man named Dan Sheehan, and said it was a habit of Carter's. If true, it would suggest the briefing affected the president deeply.
